text:
```yaml
name: Publish
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8
          run_install: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: pnpm publish --no-git-checks
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
